pcs.pc_description: identify work requirements by interpreting instructions received from supervisor or person in charge
identify and arrange tools, equipment, measuring instruments and material required for performing sheet metal cutting, forming and assembly operations as per specifications
check the tools, measuring instruments and equipment for any defects before use
check that all measuring equipment are within calibration date
use appropriate Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) for safe working in workshop

modules.module_title: Perform marking on the sheet metal

pcs.pc_description: prepare the sheet metal for marking out by cleaning, removing burrs and sharp edges and applying marking out medium on it
use a range of marking out equipment and mark the dimensions on the sheet metal materials by applying an appropriate method of marking out as per the instructions received

mark out a range of features (datum lines; cutting guidelines; square and rectangular profiles; circular and radial profiles; angles; holes linearly positioned, boxed and on pitch circles) on the sheet metal
obtain approval from supervisor or person in charge on marked out features and correct errors as per feedback received

modules.module_title: Perform sheet metal cutting and forming operations

pcs.pc_description: cut and shape the sheet metal materials to the required specification by performing appropriate cutting operations and techniques
use appropriate cutting hand and manually operated machine tools to cut the marked-out shape on the material with required finishing
perform various forming operations to produce sheet metal components of required shapes by using forming hand and manually operated machine tools
measure the cut and formed components and compare with the dimensions as prescribed in the work order and engineering drawing
assemble and secure the components in their correct positions by using appropriate assembly methods and techniques
use appropriate assembly and joining techniques to produce fabrications of required shape/geometry within ± 3.0 mm
produce products with various features, have secure and firm joints and are free from excessive tooling marks, deformation, cracking, sharp edges, slivers or burrs
follow the specified sheet metal cutting, forming and assembly sequence and procedure
monitor the sheet metal cutting, forming and assembly operation and identify any problems that occur
report to the supervisor about any problems faced or anticipated during the complete process
prepare work completion reports and necessary documentation for the higher authorities
clean and store all the tools and equipment after completion of work
dispose scrap or waste material into the disposal area in accordance with the company's policies and environmental regulations

pcs.pc_description: identify work requirements by interpreting job specification document and instructions received from supervisor
report and rectify incorrect and inconsistent information in job specification documents as per organization procedures
select grinding method/technique as per the surface finish specifications and work requirements

select stones, wheels, files or other abrasives, according to materials, sizes and shapes of work- pieces, amount of stock to be removed, finishes specified, and steps in finishing and grinding process

check the tools and equipment for any defects before use
